primary.title: Worth Wandering: Radio Aporee
primary.summary: A worldwide collection of field recordings that lets you explore the sounds of cities, forests, rivers, train stations and ordinary places, with experimental radio projects that turn listening into an entirely different way of experiencing the world.

primary.title: Link: Joshternet: An Open Network for Joshes and Independent Websites
primary.summary: Joshternet connects people who identify as Josh and the independent websites they call home—an open, decentralized network built on shared web conventions.

primary.title: Enterprise sales teams, please, I beg you, stop
primary.summary: I asked for a price on a few extra seats of software we already pay for. Two days and a pile of irrelevant questions later, I got one.
